title: Lesson 57 - That's Not How I Remember It

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: We went straight to Bay 4 after the train arrived, didn't we?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: That's not how I remember it. I remember waiting at Bay 6 while you bought the day passes.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: As I remember it, the board was already showing Bay 4 when we entered the station hall.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I may be mixing up the first board with the later announcement, but an attendant definitely pointed me toward Bay 6.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What happened before I went to the ticket machine?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: The train had arrived at nine oh five. We checked the main board, and then you went to buy the passes.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: While I was paying, were you waiting beside the shuttle sign?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Yes. I took a photo because the bay number was partly hidden by a poster.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What time does the photo show?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Nine twelve, and the sign in the photo says Bay 6.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Then my memory of going straight to Bay 4 can't be complete. What happened after the photo?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: A service alert sounded while you were walking back. It moved the nine twenty-two shuttle from Bay 6 to Bay 4.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That fits. By the time I returned, the board had changed, so Bay 4 is the part I remembered.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: The alert in my phone history is time-stamped nine fourteen.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: And my pass receipt says nine eleven. The records show that you waited at Bay 6 while I was buying the passes.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Then we both walked to Bay 4 after the alert and boarded at nine twenty-two.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: We were both right about one part and incomplete about another.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Exactly. My first version left out the change, and yours left out the original bay.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thanks for flagging that. What I meant was that Bay 4 was the only bay I saw after buying the passes.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: To avoid confusion, let's write the final sequence with both bay numbers and the alert time.
